BibleVerses.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.
In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of His grace.
As you therefore have received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk in Him.
Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.
Abide in Me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in Me.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes; there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying.
For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.
I have been crucified with Christ; it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me.
Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Commit your works to the Lord, and your thoughts will be established.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, the First and the Last.
So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.
For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of an archangel, and with the trumpet of God.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it spring the issues of life.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End, says the Lord.
You therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ all shall be made alive.
Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who trusts in Him!
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ.
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Anxiety in the heart of man causes depression, but a good word makes it glad.
And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.
And be found in Him, not having my own righteousness, which is from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ.
